Order

WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA)

After addressing the arguments at length,
learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo.

The said memo reads as under:
"MEMO In the above case, I want to withdraw the petition due to not maintainable.
Hence, it is prayed before this Court, kindly permit to withdraw the petitioner with a liberty to renew the petition after filing of charge-sheet in the interest of justice.
Hence, this memo."
NC: 2025:KHC-K:2840 HC-KAR Placing the above memo on record, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with a liberty as prayed for.

Sd/-
